plan.title: Buyer downloads the single-stage RFQ bid template

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ and retain whole-lot awarding.
Provide the mandatory event title required for publishing.
Apply the RFQ template so the product sheet is rendered.
Add the specified CYLINDER product and set its requested quantity to 10; product selection is handled through the line-item drawer.
Set the requested delivery location on the first product row.
Commit a valid event schedule required for publishing.
Add one available QA test vendor so the event can be published and the template can include a vendor column.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Open the bid-template download control on the published event stage.
Verify that a download occurred and that the readable downloaded content includes the selected product.
